title: Mittag-Leffler and Artin-Rees bounds for the cohomology of F/I^nF
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism], $\mathcal I=I\mathcal O_X\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ the image of $f^*\widetilde I\to f^*\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\to\mathcal O_X$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal], and $\mathcal F$ a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], with $\mathcal I^n\mathcal F\subseteq\mathcal F$ as in [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] (0). Fix $p\ge0$, put $H=H^p(X,\mathcal F)$ and $M_n=H^p(X,\mathcal F/\mathcal I^n\mathcal F)$ for $n\ge1$ (sheaf cohomology [pqf-def-cohomology]; these are $A$-modules, $a\in A$ acting through the image of $a$ in $\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$), let $\rho_n:H\to M_n$ be the $A$-linear map induced by the quotient map $\mathcal F\to\mathcal F/\mathcal I^n\mathcal F$, and for $k\ge n$ let $\tau_{k,n}:M_k\to M_n$ be the map induced by the quotient map $\mathcal F/\mathcal I^k\mathcal F\to\mathcal F/\mathcal I^n\mathcal F$ (so $\tau_{k,n}\circ\rho_k=\rho_n$). Then there is an integer $c\ge0$ such that (1) $\operatorname{Ker}(\rho_n)\subseteq I^{n-c}H$ for all $n\ge c$ (with $n\ge1$); and (2) $\operatorname{Im}(\tau_{k,n})=\operatorname{Im}(\rho_n)$ for all $n\ge1$ and all $k\ge n+c$. (In particular the inverse system $(M_n)_{n\ge1}$ is Mittag-Leffler.)

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 02OB (lemma-ML-cohomology-powers-ideal, line 5553), parts (1) and (3) (part (2), the Mittag-Leffler condition, is the parenthetical consequence of (3)); its proof (lines 5586-5645) uses Lemma 02OA (lemma-cohomology-powers-ideal-application, line 5452) parts (2) and (4) for H^p and H^{p+1}, which rests on Lemma 02O8 (lemma-cohomology-powers-ideal-times-F, line 5405: the graded module of the H^p(X, I^n F) is finite over the Rees algebra), Lemma 0897 (lemma-graded-finiteness) and Lemma 02O6 (lemma-proper-over-affine-cohomology-finite), plus the long exact sequences of 0 -> I^nF -> F -> F/I^nF -> 0. Stacks writes I^nF for Im(f^*(I^n)~ (x) F -> F); this equals (I O_X)^n F as used here, since the image of f^*(I^n)~ in O_X is (I O_X)^n (on an affine open Spec B of X both are I^nB). Tags verified in tags/tags: 02OB, 02OA, 02O8, 0897, 02O6.
